returning.about: Returning: last season's (2025-26) minutes and WAR still on the roster, by Barttorvik player id; transfers in = incoming D-I transfers' WAR at their old schools. WAR = wins over a replacement player (BPM + 2) x minutes x pace; see the WAR leaders tab.

cols.t: share of last season's minutes returning
last season's WAR gone (graduated, pro, transferred out)
incoming D-I transfers' WAR last season at their old schools
Ret WAR + In WAR - last season's WAR: production gained or lost before freshmen

talent.about: Talent: mean FV of the eight highest-graded players. xNBA = sum of NBA% on the roster (expected NBA players). xBPM 8 = mean projected BPM of the top eight. TvE = talent rank minus ARK Ranking rank (+ = rated above the talent).

cols.t: mean FV of the eight highest-graded players
players graded FV 45 or better (NBA rotation and up)
sum of NBA% on the roster: expected NBA players
mean projected BPM of the top eight by xBPM
ARK Ranking rating: points a game better than an average D-I team
talent rank minus ARK Ranking rank: + = playing above the roster's grades
